description: Words and phrases that promise a result. User-facing copy may not contain them unless it is bound to a stored proof run (plan section 0.4, section 5). Shared by the Rust copy lints (crates/engine/src/copy_lint.rs) and the UI copy lint (scripts/check-ui-copy.mjs). An entry that starts with a letter or digit matches at the start of a word, so 'lag' matches 'lag' and 'laggy' but not 'flag'; any other entry matches anywhere.
